title: Page 8
content_zh:
“快开门！来人哪，快点开门！”敲门敲了好一会儿，却依旧没有人来开门，焦急的戚无烟终于忍不住咆哮出声，什么形象都不顾了。
“很抱歉，戚二公子。”门仆在门内尴尬地说：“我们家小姐刚才交代下来，她不想见您。”
“不，我一定要见她，让我进去！”他非得和她把事情明白说清楚不可，她刚才的那些理由他全都不相信，她一定有所隐瞒。
“很抱歉，二公子，要让您失望了。”门仆也很无奈。
看着依旧紧闭的梁家大门，戚无烟不愿意就这么被打败，如果他在此刻放弃，或许他和昭颖之间的关系就会彻底决裂，再也无法修补。
所以无论如何，他都不能走，除非可以见到昭颖，要不然他绝不离开！
一打定主意之后，戚无烟便说：“不要紧，你们不开门，我就一直在门外等，我会等到你们愿意开门让我见昭颖一面为止。”
就算希望多么微小，只要不是毫无机会，只要还有一丝希望，他就不会放弃。
“这……”门仆瞧着背后还是跪坐在地的小姐，还真是左右为难呀。
“他要等，就让他等吧，别理他。”梁昭颖语气虚弱地说完话后，便缓缓站起身，脚步虚浮地往自己房间走去，不想再听到戚无烟的声音。
这么做应该够了吧？她已经再也说不出任何可恶狠心的话伤害他，她只希望他赶快回去，可以死心放弃她。
他尽量恨她吧，不要紧，她不会怪他的，因为这就是她的打算呀。
她不能再让他爱她，所以只能让他恨她，将原本的爱全都舍弃掉……
“颖儿！”
梁秦氏一听到仆人说梁昭颖似乎怪怪的，赶紧从房里走出来，在穿廊上见到她苍白着一张脸像是失魂般地走着，非常的不对劲。
“颖儿，怎么了？”女儿已经很久没有露出如此脆弱的表情，甚至像是快要昏倒了一样，梁秦氏担心地拦下她，关心地问：“有什么事情，跟娘说好吗？”
她不知道该如何对一直疏离的女儿表达关心，所以总是以责骂代替关怀，但此时此刻，看到女儿脆弱的神情，她除了担心之外，根本就责骂不出口，只想知道她到底怎么了。
毕竟她只剩下这唯一的女儿、唯一的亲人了，她不在乎颖儿的话，还能在乎些什么呢？梁昭颖傻傻地看着母亲关心她的神情，对母亲难得展现的关怀一时之间完全反应不过来，甚至感到……意外。
原来母亲还是担心她、在乎她的，并不像外表那样的排斥她，她的鼻头一酸，眼眶也逐渐积聚泪水。
直到这一刻，她终于明白，不管两人这些年处得再怎样不好，母亲还是把她当成女儿、当成唯一的亲人看待，并没有因此而放弃她。

“呜哇……娘……”梁昭颖终于痛哭出声，扑入梁秦氏的怀里，将内心的伤痛毫不掩饰地发泄出来。
现在的她只想在娘的怀里大哭一场，什么都不想再去想了，她好累，真的好累……
她只要娘的温暖就好，其它的她都不要了，全都不想要了……
戚无烟果真如他所说的，梁家不开门，他也就不离开，寸步不离地守在梁家大门口，马上引起其它路人们好奇的围观。
一时之间，京城内的百姓都在讨论这件事，大家都在猜测，到底是什么原因让原本即将结为亲家的戚、梁两家闹翻，变成现在这个样子。
戚无双一听到风声，便赶紧派两个弟弟一起到梁家门前，想要劝戚无烟暂时回到戚家，别这样折磨自己。
“二哥，你要不要先回家去，我们可以帮忙想其它办法让你见到梁姑娘，要不然一直站在这里，也不是办法呀！”戚无秋率先出声劝慰，真的很担心二哥会不顾一切地硬是耗在这儿。
“不，我一定要等到里头的人愿意开门为止。”他的双眼透露出强烈的决心，无人可以动摇。
“但如果梁家硬是不开门呢？”戚无雍并不想乌鸦嘴，但他们不得不考虑到最坏的情况。
“我相信只要我能够坚持下去，事情就一定会有转机的。”戚无烟早就管不了那么多，只能硬着头皮拚了。“三弟，楚婉的事就麻烦你帮忙了。”
“我知道。”戚无秋点头。“我已经派人暗中监视她，如果她有什么异常举动，或是有任何蛛丝马迹，确定图稿副本在她手上，我会马上让二哥知道。”
“三弟，谢谢你了。”有三弟帮忙，他安心不少。“你们先回去吧，我不会有事的。”
戚无秋和戚无雍对望了一眼，对他的强烈执着感到无可奈何，在屡劝不听下也只能暂时由着他，并派仆人在一旁关心情况，免得他突然之间身体出了状况也没人知道。
就这样，戚无烟在梁家门外等了两天，毅力惊人，让围观的众人莫不啧啧称奇，甚至有人还干脆开起了赌盘，纷纷押注看戚无烟到底能够撑多久。
“小姐，已经两天了，二公子还等在门外呢！”英儿趁替梁昭颖送午膳的时候提了下外头的情况，试着想要引起她的注意。
这两天梁昭颖都没有出门，只是静静地待在房里，粮行如果有要事便暂时由梁秦氏处理，所以还不至于出什么乱子。
梁昭颖虽然没有任何表示，但她微微蹙眉的表情已经透露出她的情绪，她不希望戚无烟继续这样折磨自己，还是快快回去吧。
她不能出去，不能出现在他面前，所以她只能躲在屋里，陪着他一同煎熬，有苦难言。
她一定要忍耐住，不能对他心软，绝对不能……
“小姐，您真的不理吗？”她这两天都按时观察戚无烟的情况，戚无烟的坚持不放弃让她忍不住同情起来，真希望小姐能够见他一面。

“从这一刻开始，你不要告诉我和他有关的任何事情，我不想听也不想知道。”梁昭颖强忍着伤痛回答。
“知道了，小姐。”英儿将膳食放下后，无奈地离开了。
之后英儿便来到前厅，向坐在厅里的梁秦氏报告。“夫人，小姐还是不打算理会戚二公子，还吩咐奴婢，以后别在她面前提二公子的事。”
“颖儿的态度当真还没软化？”梁秦氏蹙起眉，很担心现在的状况。
自从女儿两天前回来，抱着她痛哭出声，寻求她的慰藉之后，母女俩多年来第一次敞开心房，不再有任何芥蒂顾忌，彼此的关系渐渐开始改善，可以说是因祸得福，世事果然很难预料，谁也想不到会有这样的发展。
但女儿还是没有将退婚的原因告诉她，只说自己有不得已的苦衷，希望她能原谅，她看女儿情绪极不稳，无法再遭受任何刺激，便没有继续问下去。
她知道女儿还是深爱着戚无烟，在不知道女儿打算退婚的真正原因之前，她也无法帮什么忙，只希望事情还能有转圜的余地。
“既然她不要你提二公子的事，那你就‘拐个弯’地讲，她也拿你没奈何。”
“拐个弯？奴婢不懂。”英儿一脸不解。
“连这也不懂？”梁秦氏没好气地瞥了她一眼。“就像是……‘今天外头太阳真是大，真要晒死人了’这类的，反正你只要不要提到二公子就好了。”
“哦……奴婢懂了！”英儿恍然大悟地点点头。
“懂了就好。”她现在能帮的也只有这样了，希望女儿能够快点心软，别再互相折磨，好好的把事情给解决掉。
content_en:
"Open the door quickly! Who's here? Open the door quickly!" After knocking on the door for a while, no one came to open the door. The anxious Qi Wuyan finally couldn't help roaring, regardless of his image.
"I'm sorry, Mr. Qi." The servant said awkwardly from inside the door: "Our lady just told me that she doesn't want to see you."
"No, I must see her and let me in!" He had to explain things clearly to her. He didn't believe any of the reasons she just gave. She must be hiding something.
"I'm sorry, Second Young Master, to disappoint you." The doorman was also helpless.
Looking at the still closed door of the Liang family, Qi Wuyan was unwilling to be defeated like this. If he gave up at this moment, maybe the relationship between him and Zhaoying would be completely broken and could never be repaired.
So no matter what, he can't leave, unless he can see Zhaoying, otherwise he will never leave!
After making up his mind, Qi Wuyan said, "It doesn't matter. If you don't open the door, I will keep waiting outside the door. I will wait until you are willing to open the door and let me see Zhaoying."
No matter how small the hope is, as long as there is no chance and there is still a glimmer of hope, he will not give up.
"This..." The doorman looked at the young lady who was still kneeling on the ground behind him. He was really in a dilemma.
"If he wants to wait, let him wait and ignore him." After Liang Zhaoying finished speaking in a weak tone, she slowly stood up and walked to her room with empty steps, not wanting to hear Qi Wuyan's voice again.
That should be enough, right? She could no longer say any hateful and cruel words to hurt him. She just hoped that he would go back quickly and give up on her.
He should hate her as much as possible, it doesn't matter, she won't blame him, because this is her plan.
She could no longer make him love her, so she could only make him hate her and abandon all his original love...
"Yinger!"
As soon as Liang Qin heard the servant say that Liang Zhaoying seemed strange, she quickly walked out of the room and saw her walking in the corridor with a pale face as if she was lost. Something was very wrong.
"Ying'er, what's wrong?" It's been a long time since her daughter showed such a fragile expression, and she even looked like she was about to faint. Liang Qin stopped her worriedly and asked with concern: "Is there anything you can tell me?"
She didn't know how to express concern for her estranged daughter, so she always scolded her instead of caring. But at this moment, seeing her daughter's fragile expression, besides being worried, she couldn't scold her at all and just wanted to know what was wrong with her.
After all, she only has this only daughter and only relative left. If she doesn't care about Ying'er, what else can she care about? Liang Zhaoying looked stupidly at her mother's expression of concern for her. She was completely unable to react to her mother's rare display of care, and even felt...surprised.
It turned out that her mother was still worried about her and cared about her, and did not reject her as she seemed. Her nose became sore and tears gradually accumulated in her eyes.
Until this moment, she finally understood that no matter how bad the two had gotten along over the years, her mother still treated her as her daughter and her only relative, and did not give up on her because of this.
"Wow...Mom..." Liang Zhaoying finally cried out in pain, threw herself into Liang Qin's arms, and vented her inner pain without any concealment.
Now she just wants to cry in her mother's arms and doesn't want to think about anything anymore. She is so tired, really tired...
All she wants is the warmth of her mother, she doesn’t want anything else, she doesn’t want anything else…
Qi Wuyan did what he said. If the Liang family didn't open the door, he wouldn't leave. He stayed at the door of the Liang family and immediately attracted curious onlookers from other passers-by.
All of a sudden, the people in the capital were discussing this matter, and everyone was speculating on the reason why the Qi and Liang families, who were about to become in-laws, fell out and ended up like this.
As soon as Qi Wushuang heard the news,, and quickly sent his two younger brothers to the door of Liang's house, trying to persuade Qi Wuyan to return to Qi's house temporarily and stop torturing herself like this.
"Second brother, do you want to go home first? We can help you think of other ways for you to see Miss Liang. Otherwise, standing here all the time is not an option!" Qi Wuqiu was the first to speak out to comfort him. He was really worried that his second brother would spend all his time here.
"No, I must wait until the people inside are willing to open the door." His eyes revealed a strong determination that no one could shake.
"But what if the Liang family insists on not opening the door?" Qi Wuyong didn't want to be clumsy, but they had to consider the worst case scenario.
"I believe that as long as I can persist, things will definitely turn around." Qi Wuyan couldn't control that much for a long time, so he could only bite the bullet and fight. "Third brother, please help me with Chu Wan's matter."
"I know." Qi Wuqiu nodded. "I have sent people to secretly monitor her. If she behaves abnormally or has any clues, I will let my second brother know immediately if I make sure that she has a copy of the manuscript."
"Third brother, thank you." With the help of his third brother, he felt more at ease. "You guys go back first, I'll be fine."
Qi Wuqiu and Qi Wuyong looked at each other, feeling helpless at his strong persistence. Despite repeated advice, they could only let him go for the time being, and sent servants to look after the situation, so that no one would know about his sudden physical condition.
In this way, Qi Wuyan waited outside the door of Liang's house for two days. His perseverance was astonishing, and everyone onlookers marveled. Some even started betting on how long Qi Wuyan could last.
"Miss, it's been two days, and the second young master is still waiting outside the door!" Ying'er mentioned the situation outside while delivering lunch to Liang Zhaoying, trying to attract her attention.
Liang Zhaoying didn't go out for the past two days, she just stayed in her room quietly. If there were any important matters in the grain store, Liang Qin would temporarily handle them, so there wouldn't be any trouble.
Although Liang Zhaoying didn't express anything, her slightly frowning expression revealed her emotions. She didn't want Qi Wuyan to continue torturing herself like this, so she should go back quickly.
She couldn't go out or appear in front of him, so she could only hide in the house and suffer with him.
She must be patient and not be soft-hearted to him. She must not...
"Miss, are you really ignoring me?" She had been observing Qi Wuyan's condition on time for the past two days. Qi Wuyan's persistence in not giving up made her unable to help but sympathize. She really hoped that the lady could see him.
"From this moment on, don't tell me anything related to him. I don't want to hear or know." Liang Zhaoying answered while holding back the pain.
"I understand, miss." Ying'er put down the meal and left helplessly.
After that, Ying'er came to the front hall and reported to Liang Qin who was sitting in the hall. "Madam, the young lady still doesn't plan to pay attention to the Second Young Master Qi. She also ordered the slaves not to mention the Second Young Master's affairs in front of her in the future."
"Ying'er's attitude has really not softened yet?" Liang Qin frowned, worried about the current situation.
Ever since their daughter came back two days ago, she hugged her and cried bitterly, seeking comfort from her. For the first time in many years, the mother and daughter opened up their hearts and no longer had any grudges. Their relationship gradually began to improve. It can be said to be a blessing in disguise. Things in the world are really unpredictable. No one could have imagined that there would be such a development.
But her daughter still did not tell her the reason for breaking off the engagement. She only said that she had no choice but to ask her for forgiveness. She saw that her daughter was extremely emotionally unstable and could no longer suffer any stimulation, so she did not continue to ask.
She knew that her daughter still loved Qi Wuyan deeply. Before she knew the real reason why her daughter planned to break off the engagement, she could not do much to help. She only hoped that there would be room for change.
"Since she doesn't want you to mention the second young master, then you justTo put it bluntly, she can't do anything to you. "
"Turn a corner? The slave doesn’t understand. "Ying'er looked puzzled.
"Don't you even understand this? Liang Qin glanced at her angrily. "It's like...'The sun is really strong outside today, it's going to kill people.' Anyway, just don't mention the second young master." "
"Oh... I understand, slave! "Ying'er suddenly understood and nodded.
“It’s good if you understand. "That's all she can do to help now. I hope her daughter can relent soon, stop tormenting each other, and resolve the matter properly.
